lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke finds himself at a large shopping mall.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Maybe someone here can help me find Professor Layton.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait... is that... Professor?!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke rushes toward a man in a top hat.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor Layton!

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: Hmm? I'm afraid you have me confused with someone else, young man.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Oh... I'm sorry. You look just like someone I know.

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: No harm done. You look rather distressed. Have you eaten?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I... actually, no. Not since this morning.

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: Then allow me to buy you lunch. I insist.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Really? Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They sit together at a food court table.

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: You know, there's something wonderful about buying things. The exchange, the transaction, the satisfaction.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I guess... I've always been scared of shopping, honestly.

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: Scared? Why on earth would you be scared?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I don't know. The pressure, the choices, the... everything.

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: Ah, I see. Well, perhaps this will change your mind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The man pulls out a vintage radio from his bag.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: That radio... I've seen it before!

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: You have?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Yes! Professor Layton bought one just like it at a rummage sale!

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: Is that so? What a coincidence.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait... how did you get that? Did you steal it from him?!

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: Steal? My dear boy, I purchased this fair and square.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I need to find out what happened. Thank you for the meal!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Excuse me, are you an official? I need help finding someone.

lines.speaker: official
lines.text: An official? Why yes, yes I am. How can I assist you?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm looking for Professor Layton. And I think that man might have stolen something from him.

lines.speaker: official
lines.text: I see, I see. Very serious indeed. Tell you what, there's a hotel nearby that might be able to help.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: A hotel?

lines.speaker: official
lines.text: Yes, they have... connections. For finding people. They might even let you stay for free.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: That's very kind. Thank you!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The 'official' smirks as Luke walks away.
